about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A bit more about who I am and how I work.
about.paragraph: Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building custom web solutions for local and international clients, combining robust backend logic with carefully crafted interfaces. Alongside that, I'm completing the final stretch of my Information Systems Engineering degree (UTN). Proactive profile, strongly oriented toward problem solving, self-directed learning, and teamwork.
